verdict.rationale: Zero states it does not track, collect, or sell user data, and it can be self-hosted, which gives users control over where their email data lives. Neither point explicitly addresses AI model training, and the AI features (AI compose, Perplexity web search) come with no stated no-training terms. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out, disclosure of third-party AI providers' data-use and training terms, independent verification of the privacy claim.
